## Description {#description}

This system table contain the snapshot history of Iceberg tables existing in ClickHouse. It will be empty if you don't have any Iceberg table in ClickHouse.

## Columns {#columns}

<!--AUTOGENERATED_START-->
- `database` ([String](../../sql-reference/data-types/)) — Database name.
- `table` ([String](../../sql-reference/data-types/)) — Table name.
- `made_current_at` ([Nullable(DateTime64(3))](../../sql-reference/data-types/)) — Date & time when this snapshot was made current snapshot
- `snapshot_id` ([UInt64](../../sql-reference/data-types/)) — Snapshot id which is used to identify a snapshot.
- `parent_id` ([UInt64](../../sql-reference/data-types/)) — Parent id of this snapshot.
- `is_current_ancestor` ([UInt8](../../sql-reference/data-types/)) — Flag that indicates if this snapshot is an ancestor of the current snapshot.
<!--AUTOGENERATED_END-->
